discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_5/cis_5.1.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_5/cis_5.1.x/cis_5.6.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Manual: the Ansible role applies this only under conditions we cannot translate into a check, so it is shown as the original Ansible and goss test.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "5.6 | PATCH | Ensure 'IIS Admin Service (IISADMIN)' is set to 'Disabled' or 'Not Installed'"
  when: win11cis_rule_5_6
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_5.6
    - iisadmin
  block:
    - name: "5.6 | AUDIT | Ensure 'IIS Admin Service (IISADMIN)' is set to 'Disabled' or 'Not Installed' | Check to see if IISADMIN service exists"
      ansible.windows.win_service_info:
        name: iisadmin
      register: discovered_5_6_iisadmin_service_info

    - name: "5.6 | PATCH | Ensure 'IIS Admin Service (IISADMIN)' is set to 'Disabled' or 'Not Installed' | Disable IISADMIN service"
      when:
        - discovered_5_6_iisadmin_service_info.exists
        - not win11cis_uninstall_iis_admin_service
      ansible.windows.win_service:
        name: iisadmin
        start_mode: disabled
        state: stopped

    - name: "5.6 | PATCH | Ensure 'IIS Admin Service (IISADMIN)' is set to 'Disabled' or 'Not Installed' | Uninstall IISADMIN service"
      when:
        - discovered_5_6_iisadmin_service_info.exists
        - win11cis_uninstall_iis_admin_service
      ansible.windows.win_service:
        name: iisadmin
        state: absent
